text:
Silas: Opening this thread to capture short Qs after today's all-hands on the hiring/org changes. We'll answer here.

Maya: Short summary: shifting ~11 roles into product squads, planning ~3-5 net new hires this quarter, no involuntary layoffs.

Omar: Which teams get the extra headcount?

Maya: Product Delivery (+5) and Customer Reliability (+3). Core Runtime keeps most roles; several infra project positions are being reallocated.

Zoe: Timeline for internal transfers?

people-ops-bot: Internal transfer window opens Thu 9:00 AM PT and runs for 10 business days. Apply via the internal Careers portal.

Leah: People Ops will post templates and an FAQ tomorrow. Managers will receive lists of impacted individuals by EOD.

Omar: Are reporting lines changing for managers?

Maya: A small number of squads will report into Product Delivery for tighter alignment. No company-wide director reshuffle.

Zoe: If somebody opts out of a proposed move, what are their options?

Leah: Opt-outs are allowed. We'll work with managers to find alternative placements, re-skilling, or phased transitions. Nobody will be forced.

Silas: Thanks — we'll publish an FAQ and updated org charts on Friday. If you want a private conversation, DM @Maya or @Leah.
